symptom: `describe microflow SnowflakeRESTSQL.POST_v1_ExecuteStatement` (Evora) loses the 202 poll loop: the description calls the service once, `if not($Response/StatusCode!=202) then delay; end if;` and carries on — no back-edge (the rebuild ends where the model goes round again)
cause: One merge is both the join of `if $Variable != empty` and the header of the poll loop. The describer paired it with the `if` (splitMergeMap) and walked on after `end if`; the way round came back to an already-printed activity and stopped silently. #1055's loop-header-in-a-branch fix covered a header reached inside a branch, not a header that IS a split's join
insight: Studio Pro draws one merge for two jobs that MDL spells as two statements (the `if` closing, the `while true` opening); the rebuild has two merges, which the invariant contracts away. Same header test as #1055's (mergeIsUndescribedLoopHeader: a way round that avoids the stop and everything printed). Not authorable as one merge in MDL (the builder always gives the `if` its own merge, and an authored backward `join` trips MDL003), so the fixture builds both and folds them. Guard `TestDescribeJoinIsLoopHeader_KeepsTheBackEdge`
